column2: ENGLISH
To the Heart of the Dark
The Great Beast
§GThe Herdstone will look on this with favour.§!
§RThe Herdstone will not look kindly on this.§!
An ungor runner sets off with your message. Your [person_missed.GetRootRelation] will have it in a few weeks.\n
This union secures peace with the §Y[brayherd_warp.GetName]§!: its herds will not make war on you while it lasts.

The Great Herdstone at the Heart of the Dark calls to every true child of Chaos. The beastpaths are long and the forests unkind, and it will take months to reach it. I bellow my farewells to the herd, gather my strongest gors and set out.
To the Heart of the Dark!

After long months on the beastpaths, the trees grow black and twisted and the air thickens with the stink of the warp. We have reached the Heart of the Dark. Even from here I can feel the Great Herdstone throbbing like a second heart.
The Herdstone can wait. Let me see this place first.
Rain has hammered the forest for days. My gors huddle under the dripping trees, and in the grey gloom my thoughts turn to my late [target_relative.GetRootRelation], [target_relative.GetFirstName].
[target_relative.GetSheHeCap] died before [target_relative.GetHerHis] horns had grown.
[target_relative.GetSheHeCap] honoured the Dark Gods in all things.
[target_relative.GetSheHeCap] had the cunning of a shaman.
[target_relative.GetSheHeCap] heard the whispers of the warp.
[target_relative.GetSheHeCap] never once turned from a fight.
The whole herd followed [target_relative.GetHerHim] gladly.
[target_relative.GetSheHeCap] gave every gor [target_relative.GetHerHis] due.
[target_relative.GetSheHeCap] was gentle, for one of the herd.
[target_relative.GetSheHeCap] was a hard beast to love.
[target_relative.GetSheHeCap] knew the old lore of the herdstones.
[target_relative.GetSheHeCap] was a true child of Chaos.
You daub [target_relative.GetFirstName]'s mark on a standing stone and let the rain wash your grief away.
The dead are dead. The path goes on.

The days blur together on the beastpaths. My thoughts drift back to [Root.Capital.Capital.GetName] and to [person_missed.GetTitledFirstName]. How is [person_missed.GetSheHe] faring without me, and when will this journey end?
Halt! I must send word to my dear [person_missed.GetFirstName].
Halt! An ungor will carry a message to my friend.
Halt! My [person_missed.GetHusbandWife] should hear from me.
Halt! My [person_missed.GetFatherMother] should know I still live.
Halt! My [person_missed.GetSonDaughter] needs to hear from me.
No. The herd needs its [Root.GetTitle] at its head.

An exhausted ungor runner has brought me a message from [From.GetTitledFirstName], scratched onto a strip of bark. The road to the Heart of the Dark is long, it says, and [From.GetSheHe] thinks of me often. 'Remember when we talked about [From.GetRootMatchingPersonalityStreak]?'

An exhausted ungor runner has brought me a message from [From.GetTitledFirstName], scratched onto a strip of bark. The road to the Heart of the Dark is long, it says, and [From.GetSheHe] hopes we will spend more time together when [From.GetSheHe] returns.
I remember it well.
I hope so too.

As my warband makes camp, a hooded [brayherd_trader.GetManWoman] steps out of the trees. '[brayherd_trader.GetBestName], great [Root.GetTitle], trader in rare things.' [brayherd_trader.GetSheHeCap] unwraps a bundle of stinking furs. 'A treasure fit for a beastlord. Shall we talk price?'
That [brayherd_trader_artifact.GetName] will be mine. Name your price.
§Y[brayherd_trader_artifact.GetName]§! is added to your treasury.\n
A smooth tongue like yours could be useful to me.
The trader looks you up and down, then shrugs.\n§Y[brayherd_trader.GetTitledName]§! joins your court.\n
Gors! Take it from [brayherd_trader.GetHerHim].
Your gors cut the trader down and bring you the goods.\n
Begone, peddler.
The trader melts back into the forest.\n

An ungor messenger scurries up to my warband from the camp of [target_host.GetBestName]. [target_host.GetFirstName] has heard of my pilgrimage and invites us to rest a while by the fires of [target_host.GetHerHis] warherd at [target_host.Capital.Capital.GetName].
My rival opens [target_host.GetHerHis] camp to me? How careless.
You use your rival's hospitality to attempt a risky murder.
A warm fire and fresh meat are most welcome.
Is my old rival really ready to bury the axe?
You accept the invitation to the camp of [target_host.GetTitledFirstName].
No rest for the herd. We march on.
The fires were warm and the meat plentiful. After a few days with [target_host.GetTitledFirstName] my gors are rested, and it is time to take the path towards [brayherd_warp.GetName] again.

We have howled, feasted and wrestled side by side these past days, and I find that [target_host.GetTitledFirstName] and I have much in common. It is with some regret that we take our leave and march on towards [brayherd_warp.GetName].

During the feast [target_host.GetTitledFirstName] raises a skull cup in my honour. I drain mine in one gulp, and only then notice [target_host.GetFirstName] tipping [target_host.GetHerHis] own onto the ground, braying with laughter.
You have been a generous host.
Our herds should hunt together again.
My thanks, but the path calls.
You... treacherous... beast...
The world goes dark.
I wake in a muddy ditch beside the beastpath, my belly on fire. Tied to one of my horns is a scrap of hide with a crude warning: 'Stay out of my lands.'
Everything hurts.
Whatever was in that cup has turned your guts to water.
Fatal Hospitality
'Trust is for ungors,' I mutter as we slip away into the night, leaving screams and overturned tables behind us. A few of my gors paid with their lives to make the ruse believable. A fair price.

We are almost out of the camp when a bestigor of the guard blocks the path. Then a great bellow rises behind us: [target_host.GetTitledFirstName] is dead. For a moment the bestigor hesitates. Then he raises his axe.

In the middle of the feast, [target_host.GetTitledFirstName] announces a gift for me. Moments later the gor I sent to kill [target_host.GetHerHim] is dragged in with an arrow in his back. [target_host.GetFirstName] points a claw at me: 'Kill them all!' From every corner of the camp, bestigors close in.
[target_host.GetSheHeCap] should never have trusted me.
At least I take you with me!
There is no escape!

Deep in the forest we stumble upon a field of slaughtered soldiers. Their wounds are monstrous, and the trail of broken trees can mean only one thing: a Jabberslythe, and a big one. Surely the Dark Gods would be pleased to see such a beast slain.
Find its trail. Now!
It is long gone by now.
Following the Jabberslythe's trail, I come upon a lone bestigor. He hunts the same beast, with no more luck than me, and offers to share what he knows.
Hunt with me, then serve me.
Go your own way.
This prey is mine. Begone, or die!
After days of tracking we have the Jabberslythe trapped in a clearing. Its many eyes turn towards me. It is time to act...
Close in for the kill!
Run before it catches me!
The trail went cold days ago. The forest closes around us, every path the same, and the herd grows hungry and restless. By the time we stumble back onto the beastpath, the hunt has cost us dearly.
Cursed forest.
In a ring of bones, two bestigors are tearing at each other while a crowd of gors bellows and stamps. I could join in, or perhaps profit from the outcome.
Let me show you how it's done.
Make way, I'll try my luck!
I'll bet on the big one.
Behind a ring of standing stones, a band of bestigors worships a single Chaos god at a defiled altar, ignoring the rest of the Dark Pantheon.
Join their ceremony.
Denounce them for favouring one god over the others.
Study the symbols carved on their altar.

My gors and I push through a sprawling camp of the herds. Meat, slaves, weapons and plunder are piled high, and warriors and envoys from a dozen herds haggle and brawl. There is no shortage of things to do here.
Mhrrr... is that fresh meat?
You join the feasting contest.\n
You there, shaman. Let us trade.
You buy a §YBeastman Artifact§! from a travelling bray-shaman.\n
Brethren, keep that shaman busy...
While your gors distract a shaman, you help yourself to a §YBeastman Artifact§!.\n
I have had enough for one day.
At last I stand before the Great Herdstone. Its power is overwhelming, and the whispers of the Ruinous Powers fill my head. It is time to make my sacrifices.
Abase myself before the Herdstone.
Refuse this humiliation and storm out.
Take in the energies of the Herdstone.
The Herdstone fills me with its power!

A message arrives from [From.GetTitledFirstName], keeper of the Heart of the Dark.\n\nThe herds have heard your call. Out of the deep forest comes [brayherd_shaman.GetBestName], a bray-shaman steeped in the lore of the Dark Gods. [brayherd_shaman.GetSheHeCap] will tend your wounds and read the omens for your court.
The herd is stronger for it.
§Y[brayherd_shaman.GetBestName]§! joins your court as physician.

The herd has heard my call. Out of the deep forest comes [brayherd_strategist.GetName], a towering beast scarred by a hundred raids. It will lead my warriors in the war camp as well as on the field of battle.
Let the herd follow where it leads!
§Y[brayherd_strategist.GetName]§! arrives at your court.
A beastlord has sent gifts and asks for a bray of stature to join his herd.
Offer one of my own bloodline.
Just find him one of the fine ones.

A message arrives from [From.GetTitledFirstName], keeper of the Heart of the Dark.\n\nThe Ruinous Powers have answered the tribe of [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName]. [From.GetHerHisCap] own kin, [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetFirstName], will become the consort of [imperial_marriage_spouse_1.GetTitledFirstName].

A message arrives from [From.GetTitledFirstName], keeper of the Heart of the Dark.\n\nThe Ruinous Powers have answered the tribe of [Root.GetOnlyDynastyName]. [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetFirstName], a bray of rare beauty, will become the consort of [imperial_marriage_spouse_1.GetTitledFirstName].
A fine addition to the herd!
§Y[imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetFirstName]§! is on [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetHerHis] way and will arrive in a few weeks.
A Ruinous Union

The whole camp has gathered to see the bray sent from the Heart of the Dark. [From.GetFirstName] arrives at the head of a procession of bestigors, draped in furs and bone charms, and the herd falls silent. [From.GetSheHeCap] does not walk to meet me so much as stalk, and there is something of the warp in [From.GetHerHis] eyes. How has a beast like me earned such a [From.GetBrideGroom]?
The Dark Gods have blessed this union.

My [GetFromRelation], [From.GetTitledFirstName], has taken [imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetFirstName], a bray from the Heart of the Dark, as consort. The herds will talk of the feast for years to come.
May they breed many strong gors.
§Y[imperial_marriage_spouse_1.GetTitledFirstName]§! and §Y[imperial_marriage_spouse_2.GetFirstName]§! are now joined.\n
